name: Single Product Customizer
author: WooXperto

sections.description:
Single product page customizer plugin is a nice tool for WooCommerce Single product page. User can easily customize there Single product page. They can show/hide meta section, enable/disable plus-minus button, hide price for guest user and many more.

Commercial Plugin

👉 This plugin is free but offers additional paid commercial upgrades or support. View support

Key Features Free Version

✅ Add plus minus button: Enable plus/minus button for quantity change.
✅ Out of stock text: Change Out of stock text.
✅ Sale Badge Text: Change sales badge text.
✅ Add to cart Text: Change add to cart button text.
✅ Remove product meta: Easily Remove product meta section.
✅ Related Product: Remove related product section.
✅ Remove Rating: Remove Rating section from single product page.
✅ Hide price: Show or hide Hide price.
✅ Hide add to cart button: Hide add to cart button.
✅ Hide Short Description: Hide Short description section.
✅ Add Custom Message: Display Custom Message any location of single product page.
✅ Variation Table: Display Variations as a Table any location of single product page.
✅ Related products title: Change related product title at single product page.
✅ Upsell products title: Change Upsell product title at single product page.

Key Features Pro Version

✅ Category Based Customization: Users can customize single product page by Category Based.
✅ Product Based Customization: Easily customize single product product based.
✅ Variation Image Gallery: Display a gallery of variation images.
✅ Ajax add to cart: Add to cart by ajax, mean page not loading when user try to add to cart.
✅ Min Max quantity: Set Min Max Quantity For Single product Quantity Input Field.
✅ Custom Tab: Add Custom Tab Easily how many you want to your product page.
✅ Additional Content: Add Additional Content to Single Product page.
✅ Change Tab Default Label: Easily change tab default label at Single product page.
✅ Display Related Product Categories Grid: Displaying related product categories as Grid layout.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:
    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • After installation, click “Activate Plugin.”
  3. Install Required Plugins:
    • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin:
    • Go to Dashboard > WooCommerce > Products to customize the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Can i change add to cart button text?

    • yes, you can change add to cart button text.

  2. Can I hide product price?

    • Yes, you can easily hide product price.

  3. Can I add custom message at single product page ?

    • Yes, you can add cusotm message to single product page.

  4. Can I show/hide plus minus button?

    • Yes, you can show or hide plus minus as needed.
